name: Gyenesdiás (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and red at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Gyenesdiás: a blue shield with crosses, a bunch of grapes and a wine press, within a green wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
